name: @sherlo/root
description: Sherlo: Visual testing for React Native

scripts.lint: yarn --cwd packages/cli lint && yarn --cwd packages/react-native-storybook lint
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli && tsc --noEmit -p packages/react-native-storybook && tsc --noEmit -p contracts
scripts.test:all-units: yarn --cwd packages/cli test && yarn --cwd packages/react-native-storybook test
scripts.test:guards: cd packages/cli && ../../scripts/require-test-exec-optin.sh src/__tests__/doors-are-seams.test.ts src/commands/pose/__tests__/one-road.test.ts src/render/__tests__/renderLayerPurity.test.ts src/commands/shared/__tests__/loginOnlyCredential.test.ts src/seams/__tests__/bundlerLine.build.test.ts && npx vitest run src/__tests__/doors-are-seams.test.ts src/commands/pose/__tests__/one-road.test.ts src/render/__tests__/renderLayerPurity.test.ts src/commands/shared/__tests__/loginOnlyCredential.test.ts src/seams/__tests__/bundlerLine.build.test.ts && cd ../react-native-storybook && ../../scripts/require-test-exec-optin.sh src/__tests__/storybookReads.test.ts src/__tests__/nativeLinking.test.ts && npx vitest run src/__tests__/storybookReads.test.ts src/__tests__/nativeLinking.test.ts
